page_title: LEC 1-2 CAG | Lecce v Cagliari 19/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
90+3' Konan Ndri (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Luca Zufferli shows a yellow card to Adam Obert (Cagliari) for his blatant foul.
86' Here is a change. Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) is going off and Fabio Pisacane gives the last tactical orders to Luca Mazzitelli.
84' Konan Ndri (Lecce) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
84' Lecce quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
83' Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
80' We are about to witness a substitution. Konan Ndri (Lecce) is replacing Santiago Pierotti.
78' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lecce comes to nothing.
73' A substitution has been made. Ylber Ramadani goes off and Francesco Camarda (Lecce) comes on.
73' Fabio Pisacane prepares a substitution. Michel Adopo is replaced by Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari).
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) comes onto the pitch so that Andrea Belotti can be given a rest.
71' 1 - 2 Goal! Andrea Belotti (Cagliari) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Wladimiro Falcone into the bottom left corner.
70' Andrea Belotti (Cagliari) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
70' Referee Luca Zufferli is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Cagliari!
70' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Cagliari using VAR. Let's see what happens.
69' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle after Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. The referee blows the whistle and gives a penalty to Cagliari!!
67' Tete Morente (Lecce) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
65' Cagliari are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
61' Substitution. Tete Morente (Lecce) on for Riccardo Sottil.
60' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Matteo Prati walks off the pitch to be replaced by Mattia Felici (Cagliari).
60' Fabio Pisacane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) replacing Sebastiano Esposito.
58' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Zufferli had an easy-decision to make.
55' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) commits a foul and Luca Zufferli immediately signals a free kick.
52' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 2:7.
48' Andrea Belotti (Cagliari) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
46' Half-time substitution. Eusebio Di Francesco decided to make a change. Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is replaced by Corrie Ndaba.
46' Eusebio Di Francesco makes a switch. Mohamed Kaba is coming on in place of Alex Sala (Lecce) at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Alex Sala (Lecce) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
45+1' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the right post! What a shot that was!
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) has tested the patience of referee Luca Zufferli and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
43' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
42' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Matteo Prati (Cagliari), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
41' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Michel Adopo (Cagliari) inside the box. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Cagliari.
40' The resulting corner from Matteo Prati (Cagliari) is cleared by the defence.
39' Some great controlled play and passing from Cagliari. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
35' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Cagliari players have a reason to celebrate!
34' Wait! Referee Luca Zufferli has indicated he is going to review the Cagliari goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

33' 1 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Marco Palestra, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Andrea Belotti (Cagliari), who beats Wladimiro Falcone with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 1:1.

32' What a wasted opportunity by Marco Palestra (Cagliari)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Wladimiro Falcone makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
31' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
30' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) was too forceful with his tackle and Luca Zufferli interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
29' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Elia Caprile sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.
28' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) is adjudged offside.
27' Yellow card. Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
26' Adam Obert (Cagliari) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Luca Zufferli has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

23' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the left post, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop the effort.
22' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
21' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
20' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
18' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the right post to safety.
18' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

16' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
15' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
10' Some neat passing and movement from Lecce as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
5' 1 - 0 Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) heads the ball home after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
2' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lecce will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Luca Zufferli.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
